bio_h2: Your type-A friend with expensive taste.
bio_paragraphs: Shelby Neubauer is the founder of Haus di Lusso, a luxury lifestyle management company that oversees private clients' households and handles the logistics of their day-to-day lives. She's also a Nashville-based fashion and lifestyle creator. Between client work and content shoots, her calendar fills up fast. Staying healthy and strong isn't something she wants to put off until life slows down.

Shelby calls herself "your type-A friend with expensive taste," and wellness brings out the type-A side. From blood panels to peptides, she wants to know who's behind it and what the research actually says. That means looking for reputable labs for bloodwork and licensed pharmacies for prescriptions.
pull: When it comes to your health, you deserve to know exactly who you're trusting.
